steps.title: Cloud Computing and AWS Fundamentals
steps.description: AWS is the most widely used cloud in Indian companies and the one most cloud job postings ask for. Learn the cloud service and deployment models, AWS's global infrastructure, the shared responsibility model, the Well-Architected Framework, and service limits and quotas.

steps.title: IAM: Users, Roles and Policies

steps.title: Networking with VPC and Load Balancers
